advance_only_if: every dataset selected-local minus incumbent mAP@R >= -0.003
every dataset selected-local minus incumbent Recall@1 >= -0.001
on every dataset with selected-local Recall@1 gain >= 0.003, selected-local minus random-pair-control Recall@1 > 0.001
decision.failure: close the compact affine/local-scatter Recall@1 lane; require new teacher or token information
decision.selection: one common local arm selected by descending six-dataset macro Recall@1, macro mAP@R, then arm name

fit_only: two SHA-ordered class folds from separately materialized fit-only artifacts; actual signed-int8 codes; no outer artifact path or capability
neighbors: raw normalized fit descriptor cosine; up to three nearest same-class rows and exactly three nearest different-class rows; classes with 2-3 rows use all available positives with per-row mean weighting
storage: unchanged normalized signed-int8 128-D code, exactly 128 bytes per item
